scientific_integrity: No new claim is made for the established arch criterion, unrestricted binary universal-word enumeration, or independent validation. The first-public date identifies the earliest cited foundational source, not a publication date for the present theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the ordered binary alphabet at lengths 2k and 2k+1, not longer word lengths or larger alphabets. Finite exhaustive tests are confirmatory; the all-k theorem is proved separately by a cyclic-rotation and greedy-arch argument. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains a possible originality risk.
title: Exactly two shortest-slack Lyndon words with full binary subsequence spectra
